chapter_title_en: Slaying the Six Heroes of Chang'an
chapter_seo_title: Sleepless Night in Chang'an: Xiao Chen Slays the Six Heroes and Cripples Two Demigods
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen faces the last three of the Six Heroes in a furious battle, then uses ancient stone relics to grievously wound the White Tiger's son and the Sun God's son, fulfilling his vow and shocking the Cultivation World.
og_title: Sleepless Night in Chang'an: Xiao Chen's Vengeance
og_description: In a brutal night duel, Xiao Chen defeats the Six Heroes and cripples demigod-level enemies with the stone drill and ball, rewriting the balance of power in the World of Immortality.
twitter_title: Chang'an Massacre: Six Heroes Dead, Two Demigods Maimed
twitter_description: Xiao Chen's legendary battle in Chang'an: he kills all six young champions and nearly kills two demigods with ancient stone weapons.
